title: fix(types,plugin-detail,plugin-map,cli): small P1 sites of objectui#8347 — swimlaneField and showHeader declared by reference, two reads typed in place (objectui#11355)
body:
Refs #11355
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

This PR is the small-sites unit of objectui#8347's preparation. objectui#8347 is the parent: it removes `BaseSchema`'s `[key: string]: any` and lands last. Each site was measured on its own, at `origin/main` with objectui#8347's P1 mutation applied locally and reverted (the restore proved by blob hash and an empty `git diff HEAD`).

The Clause-② arm covers both directions. Two members are new on the TypeScript face of `@object-ui/types` (a widening), and the zod mirror now refuses a wrongly typed value for each, where `.passthrough()` used to keep it unjudged (a narrowing).

## What each site got

| package | site | key | measured | change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| types, for plugin-kanban | `ObjectKanban`'s swimlane read | `swimlaneField` | The installed 17.5.0 `object-kanban` row declares it (an optional string). The renderer reads it and the registration publishes it as an input. | Declared on both faces. The TS member is `ObjectKanbanProps['swimlaneField']`, by reference. `grouping`, the read's fallback, is untouched: objectui#11216's. |
| types, for plugin-detail | `DetailView`'s two header reads | `showHeader` | `detail-view` has no spec row. Its producer is `record:details`, which writes its own spec-declared `showHeader` onto the `detail-view` node it builds. No catalog, docs page or example authors it on `detail-view`. | Declared on both faces. The TS member takes the `record:details` row's type, by reference, so the carried key and its source cannot drift. Docs follow: the schema reference and the plugin-detail README. |
| cli | `validate`'s two `title` reads | `title` | On the parsed union, 63 of 190 arm types declare `title` and 127 reach it only through the passthrough index (read with a throwaway type probe, not committed). Under P1 one arm, `action`, has neither, which is what breaks the union-wide read. | A narrowing at the read (`'title' in data`), ⛔ not a widening of the union. Printed output unchanged. Edit kept to those lines, because PR objectui#11069 also edits this file. |
| plugin-map | the shadowed-flat-key dev warning | TS2352 | `FLAT_MAP_CONFIG_KEYS` is typed as `FlatMapConfigKeys` keys, and `MapConfigSource` carries them. | The read is typed as it stands; the `Record` conversion is gone. (Unblocked when PR objectui#11335 landed.) |

**Tests, the non-probe errors:**
- plugin-detail: the 9162 node-slot probe writes through the slot's own `SchemaNode` type instead of converting a `Record`. The tabs fixture's `text` nodes authored `text`, which no renderer reads; they author `content`, typed `TextSchema`. The two approval tests' `showHeader` now compiles against the declaration.
- plugin-charts: the props-8885 control nodes are typed by their declarations and handed to the shell's pre-gate `BaseSchema` prop as values. The inlineComboSeries-11315 fixture's `yAxis` entries lacked `field`, which the spec's `ChartAxis` requires. They were never checked: while the index signature exists, `Omit` over `ObjectChartSchema` keeps only the signature. With `series` authored, `field` binds nothing, so no mark changes.
- plugin-map: the propertiesBag-10859 helper hands unjudged document JSON to `SchemaRenderer` through `unknown`, with a comment saying why. One fixture is a spelling the validator refuses.
- app-shell: the count-badge `page:tabs` node is authored in the spec's `properties` carrier, checked against `@objectstack/spec`'s `PageTabsProps`.
- plugin-tree: re-checked after PR objectui#11335. Its non-probe count is 0.

## Handed back — not in this PR

- **app-shell `location` ×4, plus `useOfferedNavRunAction`'s ×1.** The PM's prediction held: these are `action:bar` nodes, and `ActionBarSchema` declares `location` and its renderer reads it. But that type lives in `@object-ui/components`' `renderers/action/action-bar.tsx` and is not on the package entry, so app-shell cannot import it. Typing the literals needs a one-line type export from `@object-ui/components`, which is outside this claim's file surface. Options are in the report.
- **plugin-charts `isAnimationActive` ×5.** It is not a spec key: there is no `object-chart` row, and no spec schema declares it. It is a render flag hosts compose onto `object-chart` nodes in code (the two dashboard renderers and the report renderer), and `ObjectChart` forwards it to `ChartRenderer`, which honours it. The honest fix is a TS-face declaration that is not by reference, or a typed `ObjectChart` prop. Both are outside this claim's file surface. Options are in the report.
- **plugin-gantt:** `ObjectGantt.tsx`'s TS2352 conversion (serial behind objectui#11168 slice 4), and, re-derived here, the same `Record`-to-`BaseSchema` conversion in `ObjectGantt.propertiesBag-10859.test.tsx`.
- **plugin-kanban** `grouping` (objectui#11216) and `sort` ×2 (objectui#8174): untouched.
- **Ceiling pins, objectui#8347's flips:** plugin-charts `xAxisKy` ×2 and `objectNme`; plugin-grid `dataTableSchemaSlot-6459`'s `bogusKeyRefusedNowhere` and its two `Expect` lines (`_UpstreamHasIndex`, `_RawIsAlwaysTrue`), whose docblocks say they go red when the signature goes; plugin-map `enableClusterng`; plugin-tree `objectNaem` and the 8655 absent-key control; plugin-list `visibleWhn` ×2.

## Readings at `e20a8cbc6` (the merge of `origin/main` `edfcf5a5e`)

Each package's `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, un-chained:
- **Control**, signature present: 17 programs over 9 packages, 0 `error TS` lines.
- **With P1**: app-shell 4 / 5 (the handed-back `location` sites); plugin-detail 0 / 0; plugin-kanban 3 / 3 (`sort` ×2, `grouping`); cli 0; plugin-charts 0 / 8 (`isAnimationActive` ×5, three probes); plugin-grid 0 / 3 (pins); plugin-map 0 / 1 (pin); plugin-tree 0 / 2 (pins); plugin-gantt 1 / 2 (handed back).
- The error set matched the previous pass at `d538ead13` line for line, apart from line numbers.

## Proof the pins can fail (at `5e5ef97b0`)

Each leg used `ablation-replace` (the anchor hit once, the write was verified on disk, and the restore was proved by blob hash plus an empty `git diff HEAD`):
- zod `swimlaneField` renamed: `small-p1-sites-11355` red, 1 failed / 5 passed.
- zod `showHeader` renamed: red, 1 failed / 5 passed.
- TS `swimlaneField` renamed: `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` red on the pin's two `Expect` rows, and on `zod-mirror-parity` (mirror-only key).
- TS `showHeader` renamed: the same shape.
- **Reverse verification across the package boundary:** plugin-detail's `DetailView.approvalBand.test.tsx` with `showHeader: 'no'` gives TS2322 against the rebuilt `@object-ui/types` `.d.ts`.

The src of plugin-detail, plugin-kanban, plugin-charts and app-shell is unchanged; only their tests changed, and each edited test file ran.

## Acceptance notes

Observations, not filed. Carrier for each: objectui#8347.
- **No `properties` carrier on the TS face.** After the removal, no node type in `@object-ui/types` declares the spec's `properties` carrier. A fresh spec-carrier literal written straight into `SchemaRenderer`'s `schema` prop stops compiling. The count-badge test now passes a typed value.
- **ObjectChartBlock's pre-gate prop.** Its `schema` prop is the pre-gate `BaseSchema` (ruling `5810232641`). After the removal, a fresh `object-chart` literal carrying `objectName` no longer compiles at that prop; a typed value does.
- **`Omit` over a signature-carrying type keeps only the signature**, so a test parameter typed that way checks nothing until the removal. inlineComboSeries-11315 is the instance found and fixed here.
- **The parsed union's `action` arm loses its passthrough index under P1.** It is the only arm then left with neither `title` nor an index signature.
